meaning.en: Everything looking the same, with no individuality.
meaning.zh: 一千个人只有一副面孔，比喻千篇一律，缺乏个性。

equivalents: all cut from the same cloth

examples.zh: 这些影视剧人物千人一面，毫无新意。
examples.en: The characters in these dramas are all alike, with nothing new.

examples.zh: 新建的小区千人一面，缺少特色。
examples.en: The new housing estates all look the same, lacking character.

usage.en: Usually of art, design or cities.
usage.zh: 多用于文艺作品、设计、城市等。

meaning.en: To deploy troops and assign commanders; also to marshal people for a task.
meaning.zh: 调动、派遣军队；也比喻调配人力。

examples.zh: 总指挥正在调兵遣将，准备迎战。
examples.en: The commander is deploying his forces for battle.

examples.zh: 公司为这个项目调兵遣将，集中了最强的团队。
examples.en: The company marshalled its strongest team for the project.

pinyin: qián yán bù dā hòu yǔ
literal: front · words · not · join · back · speech

meaning.en: Speaking incoherently, with no link between one part and the next.
meaning.zh: 说话前后不连贯，缺乏条理。

examples.zh: 他喝醉了，说话前言不搭后语。
examples.en: He was drunk and spoke incoherently.

examples.zh: 她紧张得前言不搭后语。
examples.en: She was so nervous that her words made no sense together.

usage.en: Predicate; also written 前言不对后语.

pinyin: shù yù jìng ér fēng bù zhǐ
literal: tree · wants · calm · but · wind · not · stop
natural: the tree wants calm but the wind won't stop

meaning.en: Often followed by 'but children's wish to care for parents cannot wait'; one's wish for peace is thwarted by forces beyond control, and filial duty should not be delayed.
meaning.zh: 常与“子欲养而亲不待”连用，比喻事情不以人的意志为转移，也劝人及时尽孝。

equivalents: the tree would be still but the wind will not stop

examples.zh: 树欲静而风不止，子欲养而亲不待，我们要趁早孝敬父母。
examples.en: The tree longs for calm but the wind won't stop; show your parents devotion while you can.

examples.zh: 他想平静地生活，可树欲静而风不止。
examples.en: He wanted a quiet life, but the winds of trouble wouldn't stop.

story.en: Gao Yu the Tall lamented: 'The tree wants to be still but the wind will not stop; the son wants to care for his parents but they are no longer there' (树欲静而风不止，子欲养而亲不待).
story.zh: 《韩诗外传》：“树欲静而风不止，子欲养而亲不待也。”

usage.en: Often cited with 子欲养而亲不待.
usage.zh: 常与“子欲养而亲不待”连用。

meaning.en: Very lucky and profitable.
meaning.zh: 非常吉祥顺利。

examples.zh: 新店开张，大吉大利！
examples.en: The new shop opens: may it prosper!

examples.zh: 祝你今年事事大吉大利。
examples.en: Wishing you good fortune in everything this year.

meaning.en: To advise and warn with earnest, patient sincerity.
meaning.zh: 恳切耐心地劝告、告诫。

examples.zh: 老师对学生谆谆告诫，要诚实做人。
examples.en: The teacher earnestly urged the students to be honest.

examples.zh: 父亲的谆谆告诫，他一直记在心里。
examples.en: He has always remembered his father's earnest warnings.

meaning.en: To live forever without growing old.
meaning.zh: 永远活着，不会衰老。

examples.zh: 秦始皇一心想要长生不老。
examples.en: The First Emperor of Qin longed for immortality.

examples.zh: 世上没有长生不老的药。
examples.en: There is no elixir of eternal life in this world.

meaning.en: Strong enough to crush any obstacle.
meaning.zh: 没有攻不破的坚固事物，形容力量强大。

examples.zh: 这支军队被誉为无坚不摧。
examples.en: The army was known as invincible.

examples.zh: 团结起来，就有无坚不摧的力量。
examples.en: United, we have a force that can smash any obstacle.

meaning.en: Face lit up with delight.
meaning.zh: 眉头舒展，眼含笑意，形容非常高兴。

examples.zh: 拿到奖状，孩子笑得眉开眼笑。
examples.en: Getting the certificate, the child was beaming.

examples.zh: 听到好消息，他眉开眼笑。
examples.en: He was all smiles at the good news.

meaning.en: Trees of fire and flowers of silver: dazzling festival lights or fireworks.
meaning.zh: 树上挂满灯火，花朵银白，形容灿烂的灯火或焰火。

examples.zh: 元宵节夜晚，街头火树银花。
examples.en: On the night of the Lantern Festival, the streets blazed with lights.

examples.zh: 烟花绽放，天空火树银花。
examples.en: Fireworks burst, turning the sky into a blaze of light.

story.en: Su Weidao's poem on the fifteenth night of the first month: 'Fire trees and silver flowers join, the star-bridge's gates are open' (火树银花合，星桥铁锁开).
story.zh: 苏味道：“火树银花合，星桥铁锁开。”

meaning.en: To take charge of everything alone, leaving no room for others.
meaning.zh: 独自包揽所有事情，不让别人参与。

examples.zh: 这次活动是他一手包办的。
examples.en: He ran the whole event single-handedly.

examples.zh: 父母不应一手包办孩子的一切。
examples.en: Parents shouldn't take over everything for their children.

meaning.en: The Four Books and Five Classics, the core texts of Confucianism.
meaning.zh: 儒家的经典著作：《大学》《中庸》《论语》《孟子》和《诗》《书》《礼》《易》《春秋》。

equivalents: the Four Books and Five Classics

examples.zh: 古代读书人必须熟读四书五经。
examples.en: Scholars in ancient times had to know the Four Books and Five Classics by heart.

examples.zh: 他从小背诵四书五经。
examples.en: He learnt the Four Books and Five Classics from childhood.

usage.en: Noun; also humorously for traditional learning.
usage.zh: 名词；也可戏指传统学问。

meaning.en: As solid as a city of metal walls with boiling moats.
meaning.zh: 像金属造的城墙和滚水的护城河那样牢固，比喻防守十分稳固。

examples.zh: 这座城堡固若金汤。
examples.en: The fortress is impregnable.

examples.zh: 他们的防线固若金汤，对手无从下手。
examples.en: Their defence is rock-solid, giving opponents no way through.

story.en: Kuai Tong said that the cities were 'all walls of metal and moats of boiling water' (皆为金城汤池，不可攻也).
story.zh: 《汉书》：“皆为金城汤池，不可攻也。”

meaning.en: To master a skill without a teacher.
meaning.zh: 没有老师教，自己就学会了。

examples.zh: 他的吉他是无师自通的。
examples.en: He taught himself the guitar.

examples.zh: 她无师自通，学会了编程。
examples.en: She learnt to code by herself.

meaning.en: To visit someone repeatedly and sincerely to recruit them.
meaning.zh: 三次拜访茅庐，比喻诚心诚意地一再邀请或拜访。

examples.zh: 公司三顾茅庐，才请到这位专家。
examples.en: The company only landed the expert after repeatedly courting him.

examples.zh: 他三顾茅庐，终于说服了老教授出山。
examples.en: After many visits, he persuaded the old professor to join.

story.en: Zhuge Liang recalled that Liu Bei 'visited me three times in my thatched hut' (三顾臣于草庐之中).
story.zh: 诸葛亮：“先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中。”

usage.en: Predicate; from Liu Bei seeking Zhuge Liang.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；源于刘备请诸葛亮出山。

meaning.en: Having a big, protruding belly.
meaning.zh: 形容肚子肥大的样子。

examples.zh: 这位大腹便便的老板走进了餐厅。
examples.en: The pot-bellied boss walked into the restaurant.

examples.zh: 他应酬太多，渐渐大腹便便。
examples.en: He socialised so much that he grew pot-bellied.

meaning.en: Singing and dancing to celebrate peace; now often implying complacency.
meaning.zh: 唱歌跳舞，庆祝太平，现多用来讽刺粉饰太平。

equivalents: revel in an age of peace

examples.zh: 外患未除，岂能歌舞升平？
examples.en: With enemies at the gates, how can we revel in peace?

examples.zh: 城里一片歌舞升平的景象。
examples.en: The city was a scene of peaceful revelry.

meaning.en: Two sides so opposed that they cannot co-exist.
meaning.zh: 双方矛盾尖锐，不能同时存在。

examples.zh: 这两家公司势不两立。
examples.en: The two companies are irreconcilable rivals.

examples.zh: 他们为一点小事闹得势不两立。
examples.en: They fell out irreconcilably over something trivial.

meaning.en: Having deep, constant feeling for a person or thing.
meaning.zh: 对人或事物怀有深厚而专一的感情。

examples.zh: 他对她一往情深，多年不变。
examples.en: He is deeply devoted to her, unchanged over the years.

examples.zh: 她对京剧一往情深。
examples.en: She has a deep and abiding love for Peking opera.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对…一往情深”。

meaning.en: Hesitant and unable to make decisions.
meaning.zh: 做事犹豫，缺乏决断。

examples.zh: 他性格优柔寡断，错失了许多机会。
examples.en: He's indecisive by nature and has missed many opportunities.

examples.zh: 领导不能优柔寡断。
examples.en: A leader can't afford to be indecisive.

meaning.en: To run away at the mere news of someone's approach.
meaning.zh: 一听到风声就逃走，形容十分害怕。

examples.zh: 敌军闻风而逃。
examples.en: The enemy fled at the first rumour of attack.

examples.zh: 听说检查组要来，他们闻风而逃。
examples.en: Hearing inspectors were coming, they fled at once.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，可参看“闻风丧胆”。

meaning.en: Speaking haltingly and stuttering.
meaning.zh: 说话不流利，断断续续。

examples.zh: 他紧张得结结巴巴，说不出完整的话。
examples.en: He was so nervous he stammered and couldn't finish a sentence.

examples.zh: 她结结巴巴地解释了半天。
examples.en: She stammered through a long explanation.

meaning.en: Murder and arson; any violent wickedness.
meaning.zh: 指凶恶的犯罪行为。

examples.zh: 他从没干过杀人放火的事。
examples.en: He has never committed murder or arson.

examples.zh: 那帮人杀人放火，无恶不作。
examples.en: That gang committed murder and arson, doing every evil.
